data.one_liner: Flutter widget that arranges buttons in a grid layout.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GridButton widget that arranges interactive buttons in a configurable grid layout. Useful for creating number pads, calculators, and similar input interfaces.
use_when: Building a number pad or calculator interface
Arranging multiple buttons in a structured grid layout
avoid_when: You need complex staggered grid layouts requiring advanced positioning
strengths: Simple and declarative syntax for button grids
Supports custom items with titles, child widgets, and flex values

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a more advanced and flexible staggered grid layout for complex UI designs.
